systems.platform: WAPIS, on local, regional and global platforms
systems.owner: Sierra Leone Police, with EU funding through INTERPOL; EU funding was to end in November 2024 and the force was urged to take full ownership
systems.tiers: 7 work stations at the start, after joining on 2022-01-26, and 21 by 2024-10-08, when equipment for 100 work stations across the country was handed over; the page does not say where the work stations are, nor that stations enter reports or cases in the system

note: The Sierra Leone Police describe WAPIS as an electronic criminal data record for tracking and for crime trend analysis, with no statement that a station records a report or a case in it, so it is not of the record class and gives no fact. The Inspector General notes electricity and internet problems in certain areas.
